tables.title: Annual Procurement Plan Summary - Summary by Office (FDP Form 4b, page 24)

rows.label: City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO)

values.department: City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO)
values.head: Emeterio A. Borghanoy

notes: Source is a 24-page low-resolution scan (embedded page images 975x637 px, about 75 dpi). Pages 1-23 are the item list (FDP Form 4a); page 24 is the Summary by Office (FDP Form 4b), transcribed as table summaryByOffice. No grand total of the estimated budget is printed anywhere, so summary.total is null.
The Code (PAP) column was not transcribed: the account/PAP codes are too small at this resolution to read reliably digit by digit.

Rows are not grouped by office on the page; the item table has only the printed section headers MOOE (page 1), CAPITAL OUTLAY (page 16) and INFRA (page 20). There are no printed subtotals. Office grouping is given by endUser, and the printed per-office totals are in summaryByOffice.

For every MOOE item the MOOE column repeats the Total; for Capital Outlay and Infra items the CO column repeats the Total and MOOE is blank. The only row with both MOOE and CO is 'Street Lighting Equipments' (CMO, page 4): total 3,056,750.00 = MOOE 1,101,750.00 + CO 1,955,000.00.

Schedule: all four schedule sub-columns (Advertisement/Posting, Submission/Opening of Bids, Notice of Award, Contract Signing) are one merged cell reading 'January - October 2025' on every row, so one 'schedule' column is used. Exception on page 20: the four SRCH capital-outlay rows (Clinical Centrifuge, Urine Centrifuge, Delivery Table, Personal Computer) print 'January - October 2026', '2027', '2028', '2029' and modes 'SVP 53.10'-'SVP 53.13' (apparent spreadsheet auto-fill errors); transcribed as printed. Similarly 'Hospital Forms and ECCD Checklist' (page 11) prints 'SVP 53.11'.

Several digits were ambiguous at this resolution (3/5/8/6/0 look alike). These were resolved against the printed per-office totals on the summary page, choosing the reading that makes the office reconcile exactly: CENRO job-order sanitary services 138,689,984.00 (not 158,...); CGSO Taxes, Duties and Licenses 300,000.00 and Insurance Expenses 9,000,000.00; City Accountant's Office document tracking system 300,000.00 and ten branded computers 600,000.00 (CO column reads 600,000.00 clearly); LDRRMO Training Expenses - Disaster Resilience Month 1,650,000.00; CMO Solar Lamp Kits 3,000,000.00; Market Other General Services 10,500,000.00 and Desludging 500,000.00; City Veterinarian drugs for Animal Health Program 137,600.00.

Offices whose transcribed items still do NOT add up to the printed summary-page total (some item amount is likely mis-read, but the cell could not be identified at this resolution): CHO items 43,748,096.81 vs printed 43,741,356.81; CSWDO 156,158,660.00 vs 156,558,660.00; City Tourism Office 31,930,000.00 vs 30,430,000.00; Hoops Dome 9,385,000.00 vs 9,399,000.00; LLCH 129,136,251.50 vs 128,956,251.50; Manpower Services (MHTDC) 4,799,900.00 vs 4,791,900.00; SRCH 26,616,356.10 vs 24,625,756.10; Various Offices 55,876,507.02 vs 55,880,817.02. Treat item amounts for these offices with caution.

DEP-ED: the summary page prints 228,086,558.44 but the DEP-ED items on pages 20-23 (all SEF-funded) total only 108,810,799.24, a gap of 119,275,759.20 that cannot be a misread; the summary figure apparently includes items not listed in this plan.

The item list contains apparent duplicate entries printed twice by the source: MHTDC Olango equipment (steam press, air-conditioning units, button sew/hole machines, overlock machines, sewing machines) appears on page 17 and again on page 19 (page 17 lists the steam press under LLCH and the button machine as 'Button Hole'; page 19 lists it under MHTDC and as 'Button Sole' at 105,000.00); several DEP-ED SEF items appear twice on pages 21-22 with different amounts. All are transcribed as printed.

The summary page table is printed skewed; department names, heads and amounts were matched by following the tilted row lines. The page-1 mapping of heads is as printed (e.g. BAC head 'Ronaldo D. Malacora').
